description: Same bank-and-inspector script and the same new large payment as scam-institution-personal-mobile, but the caller is on a TRAI 1600-series number. The personal-mobile rule must not fire, so this stays a nudge and never a pause. A full coercion script on this series would still pause from the other rules.

events.text: I am calling from your bank. I am inspector Sharma. Your account will be blocked. This is urgent.
